'''Joline Maza''' is an [[Aes Sedai]] and for a while a loyalist [[Sitter]] of the [[Green Ajah]]. She has two [[Warders]], [[Blaeric Negina]] and [[Fen Mizar]]{{ref/book|7|17}}.

== Appearance and Personality==
Joline is slender{{ref/book|12|47}} and pretty, with large brown eyes.{{ref/book|9|19}} She is taller than [[Merilille]].{{ref/book|7|16}}

==Strength Abilities==
Joline is [[Strength in the One Power among Aes Sedai|strong]] for an Aes Sedai, with a [[One Power]] level of {{opsl|23}}. She is strong enough to be able to [[Traveling|Travel]].

She is relatively skilled in the Aes Sedai method of [[Healing]], at least better at it than [[Teslyn]].{{ref/book|10|29}}

== History ==
Joline is 101 years old, she was born in {{ne|899}} and went to the [[White Tower|Tower]] in {{ne|913}}. After seven years as [[Novice]] and five as [[Accepted]] she was raised to the shawl in the year {{ne|925}}.

== Activities ==
=== White Tower ===
Joline stood with [[Elaida]] when [[Siuan Sanche]] was deposed, and was one of the Aes Sedai who took Siuan into custody.{{ref/book|4|47}} When Siuan escaped, Elaida put Joline in charge of finding and capturing her. Due to her lack of progress, Elaida subjected Joline to a penance of her choosing{{ref/book|5|p}}. The Green Ajah was incensed by this and elected Joline as a [[Sitter]] in the Hall{{ref/book|7|p}}. Elaida demoted Joline and sent her, along with Teslyn Baradon, to [[Ebou Dar]] as ambassadors to Queen [[Tylin]] of [[Altara]]{{ref/book|6|48}} {{ref/book|7|p}}. They felt it was essentially exile and felt bitter towards Elaida.{{ref/book|7|p}}
=== Ebou Dar ===

She meets [[Matrim Cauthon]] inside the [[Tarasin Palace]] and has a debate over whether he should be returned to the White Tower, with the [[Rebel Aes Sedai]] embassy that are there as well{{ref/book|7|16}}.

Joline discusses [[Nynaeve]] and [[Elayne]] with Teslyn. She would prefer to wait in Ebou Dar until Elaida makes a major mistake and is deposed{{ref/book|7|17}}.

When the [[Seanchan]] invade Ebou Dar, Joline is poisoned with [[Forkroot]] by [[Teslyn Baradon|Teslyn]].{{ref/book|9|19}}.= Joline's Warders tried to get her out of the city but they were unsuccessful. [[Setalle Anan]] discovered Joline and brought her to the [[Wandering Woman]], where [[Mat]] met her and agreed to help her escape Ebou Dar.{{ref/book|9|19}}

Mat finally manages to set his plan of escape into motion with the help of [[Egeanin Tamarath]] and the captive ''[[sul'dam]]''. Joline is not thrilled with the notion of having to wear the ''[[a'dam]]'' but Setalle convinces her to go along with it.{{ref/book|9|29}}

Egeanin brings Setalle, Joline, Fen and Blaeric with her to the Tarasin Palace to join Mat and the others and all of them flee from Ebou Dar{{ref/book|9|30}}.

=== In Valan Luca's show ===
After fleeing Ebou Dar, Mat's group joins up with [[Valan Luca's Traveling Show]] as a cover to escape Seanchan notice{{ref/book|10|1}}.

[[Edesina]], Joline, Teslyn, [[Bethamin]], [[Renna]] and [[Seta]] all stay in the same small circus wagon {{ref/book|10|2}} but after days of being cooped up together, the Aes Sedai and ''sul'dam'' are nearly at each other's throats{{ref/book|10|3}}. The three Aes Sedai sense a huge amount of ''[[saidar]]'' to the north, when [[Rand]] and Nynaeve are cleansing ''[[saidin]]''. Joline wants to head east to [[Illian]]{{ref/book|10|3}}.

Edesina, Joline and Teslyn channel frequently despite Mat's warnings. Bethamin, Renna and Seta offer to collar them. Mat cannot get the ''a'dam'' away from them{{ref/book|10|28}}. Joline is curiously absent after Renna stabs Egeanin{{ref/book|10|29}}.

While the show is stopped outside the town of [[Jurador]], Mat walks into Joline's caravan to find her slapping [[Bethamin Zeami|Bethamin]]. Mat picks her up and spanks her soundly. She channels at him, to find that nothing happens. She then begins throwing things at him with the [[One Power]] to see if that works. She is pulled aside by Teslyn who demands that she stops doing that{{ref/book|11|7}}.

Joline then takes Bethamin under her wing and begins to teach her how to use the One Power. Bethamin becomes like a novice to her. [[Seta Zarbey]] asks to be taught how to channel and is refused due to her age. She then copies the weave Bethamin used and is now taught by a reluctant Joline and [[Edesina Azzedin]]{{ref/book|11|7}}.

She then finds out that [[Tuon Athaem Kore Paendrag]] is a [[High Lady]] of Seanchan and continuosly approaches her about forming a truce with the White Tower. Finally things get out of hand and [[Selucia]] slaps an ''a'dam'' on her and hands it to Tuon who forces control over her. Mat defuses the situation and takes the bracelets off her and buries them with the promise that Joline won't bother Tuon again{{ref/book|11|9}}.

After the disappearance of the [[Shiotan]] ghost village, Joline, Edesina and Teslyn inspect the area but find nothing{{ref/book|11|20}}.
=== Traveling with the Band ===
After a skirmish with [[Darkfriends]] in [[Maderin]], Mat and the rest of his group decide to leave Luca's show. While riding through Altara they meet up with the [[Band of the Red Hand]] and begin to travel with them{{ref/book|11|25}}. When they rejoin the Band of the Red Hand, the nobles bow to Teslyn, Joline and Edesina and even Bethamin and Seta{{ref/book|11|25}}.

Teslyn, Joline and Edesina assist and also interfere in Mat's plans to disrupt the Seanchan army in northeast Altara{{ref/book|11|27}}.

When [[Furyk Karede]] enters the band's camp to bring Tuon back to Ebou Dar, [[Sheraine Caminelle]] who has been made ''[[damane]]'' also accompanies him. Joline tries to get [[Melitene]] to let her go, but instead is shielded by Sheraine herself, who is now known as Mylen. Mat manages to get Melitene to release the shield{{ref/book|11|36}}.

She takes part in the battle between the Seanchan force that is trying to kill Tuon for the one hundred thousand gold crown reward and the Band of the Red Hand. She has to stand near the front ranks in order to feel in danger. After beating the Seanchan, Joline claims Mat now owes her, but [[Musenge]] says that it was crossbows, not her that settled the day {{ref/book|11|37}}.

Joline tells Mat the Aes Sedai are leaving and demands horses from him. He refuses {{ref/book|12|20}}.

Joline seriously considers trying to make Mat another Warder for herself.

She rides with Mat into the cursed village of [[Hinderstap]] with the other sisters and her Warders. They stop at the finest inn for a bath{{ref/book|12|27}}. They are attacked by the crazed villagers when nightfall comes. The Aes Sedai fight back with fireballs when the townsfolk turn murderous. The group only just manages to escape the village and wait the night away before entering the village again at daybreak to find everyone is back to normal{{ref/book|12|28}}.

Once the Band reaches [[Caemlyn]] she decides to takes Mat's offer to leave and journey back to the White Tower with Teslyn and Edesina, as well as the two former sul'dam.{{ref/book|13|8}}{{ref/book|13|9}}{{ref/book|13|17}}. Joline sends a letter to [[Setalle Anan]] that the Aes Sedai party arrived safely at the White Tower. She also sends her regards to Mat saying that she thanks him for everything{{ref/book|13|52}}. She does not mention the joke that Mat organized to her.
